assist.scope: source-addressed downside, execution-risk and falsifier evidence only; no numeric underwriting or score

observations: Updated Q2 revenue was $13.5 million and GAAP operating loss was $29.9 million.
The updated revenue/guidance reflected a timing shift in revenue recognition for two government contracts, with no change to cash or underlying business assumptions.
The company updated FY2026 revenue guidance to approximately $45.1 million.
Q2 operating cash flow of $13.2 million included a $27.4 million temporary payroll-tax working-capital benefit; excluding it, operating cash burn was approximately $14 million.
Quarter-end cash, restricted cash and available-for-sale securities were $582 million with no debt.
The Commerce LOI contemplated up to $100 million of proposed funding and possible government equity, subject to definitive agreements and approvals.
The company reiterated a target of 30 logical qubits in 2026.

riskEvidence.observedWeakness: Q2 GAAP operating loss materially exceeded quarterly revenue, and headline positive operating cash flow depended on a temporary $27.4 million payroll-tax timing benefit.
riskEvidence.whyItMatters: Alpha should distinguish liquidity runway from operating self-funding; current liquidity is strong, but quarterly economics are not yet self-sustaining.
riskEvidence.improvementPath: Track normalized operating cash burn, gross margin and customer-level recurring economics as commercialization scales.
riskEvidence.falsifier: Sustained positive operating cash flow after removing working-capital timing effects, alongside improving operating-loss/revenue conversion.

riskEvidence.observedWeakness: Q2 revenue and FY2026 guidance were revised upward because of a timing shift in revenue recognition for two government contracts rather than a change in cash or underlying business assumptions.
riskEvidence.whyItMatters: Reported growth can move independently of cash realization and therefore should not be treated as equivalent to incremental commercial demand.
riskEvidence.improvementPath: Separate cash-backed new demand from accounting timing and track contract realization against prior awarded/booked claims.
riskEvidence.falsifier: Future growth is corroborated by cash collections and new third-party commercial deployments rather than recognition timing.

riskEvidence.observedWeakness: The Commerce LOI is proposed funding subject to definitive agreements/approvals, while the 30-logical-qubit target remains a forward technical milestone.
riskEvidence.whyItMatters: Conditional government support and technical targets should not be capitalized as realized recurring economics before contractual and technical closure.
riskEvidence.improvementPath: Verify executed funding agreements, cash receipts, independent milestone validation and customer economics from Sqale deployments.
riskEvidence.falsifier: Executed funding plus independently verified logical-qubit performance and repeat commercial workloads with measurable customer value.

contradictions.statement: Rapid reported revenue growth and strong liquidity coexist with operating losses substantially above quarterly revenue and normalized cash burn.
contradictions.resolutionPath: Council Alpha should quantify risk/score treatment using source-addressed operating-loss, normalized cash-burn and liquidity evidence.

unknowns: Customer concentration and contract mix between government and commercial buyers.
Normalized gross margin and cash-burn trajectory after the payroll-tax timing reversal.
Independent validation and customer economics of the 30-logical-qubit milestone and Sqale workloads.

gatingStatus.note: This evidence supports Alpha risk underwriting but does not set a numeric risk score or canonical state.
